categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: the design, production, and sales of power chips and motion control products. The power chip segment focuses on MOSFET and related semiconductor devices, while the motion control segment produces controllers and modules mainly for electric two- and three-wheeled vehicles.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include power semiconductor chip design (e.g., trench MOSFET, shield gate trench MOSFET, superjunction MOSFET) and integrated motion control systems combining hardware and software. Production methods involve a fabless model for wafer manufacturing, outsourced packaging and testing, and in-house assembly of motion controllers using SMT technology and automated production lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading electric two- and three-wheeled vehicle manufacturers, electric tool makers, consumer electronics, and home appliance companies. The company serves primarily the electric vehicle market in China, with products also applicable to industrial automation and emerging sectors like AI and IoT.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are concentrated in China, with major markets in East China, South China, and North China regions. The company’s registered and operational bases are in Jiangsu Province, specifically Zhangjiagang and Suzhou.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates both upstream and downstream in the power electronics supply chain, designing power semiconductor chips (upstream) and producing motion control products (downstream). It integrates chip design, packaging, and controller assembly, positioning itself as a vertically integrated player in the electric vehicle power electronics industry.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding R&D in power chips and motion control products, enhancing integration of chip and controller development, and building a packaging and testing production line. The company focuses on intelligent, high-power, and integrated control solutions, aiming to lead in new energy vehicle drive technologies and improve product reliability and cost competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of power chips (wafers and packaged products) and motion control products (controllers and modules). The company mainly uses a direct sales model supplemented by some distributor sales, with sales contracts often based on framework agreements and individual purchase orders.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in the electric two-wheeler motion control market and one of the few with vertical integration in power electronics in China. It competes in a fragmented power semiconductor market with many players but leverages its upstream-downstream synergy as a competitive advantage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 330 million, a 26.5% decline from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 37 million, down 55.6%. The decline was due to market regulatory challenges and increased R&D and management expenses. The company has about 557 employees and continues to invest heavily in R&D, with a 28.4% increase in R&D spending in 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its vertically integrated business model combining power chip design and motion control product manufacturing, enabling optimized product matching and enhanced reliability. Its strong R&D capabilities, customized solutions for leading electric vehicle manufacturers, and advanced production automation provide differentiated value in product performance, cost efficiency, and supply chain responsiveness.
